title: QUATERNIUS
credit: Universal Animation Library 1 and 2 by Quaternius (quaternius.com), CC0 1.0 (public domain).
legend: Readable key poses (the my-3D2dge format). Times in seconds; every other number is a whole number. Rig frame: forward, right, up.
L and R are the figure's own sides. Directions are percentages and need not add up: [100, 0, 0] and [50, 0, 0] agree.
hips   [forward, right, up]   the pelvis, in percent of standing hip height (100 = standing, 55 = sitting on a chair)
body   [turn, lean, tilt]     the pelvis, degrees: turn + = toward the right, lean + = forward, tilt + = toward the right
chest  [turn, lean, tilt]     the chest, relative to the pelvis; head [turn, lean, tilt] relative to the chest
shL shR    [reach, shrug]     degrees the shoulder swings forward (into a punch or an aim) and up, from rest

armL armR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  which way the arm points from the shoulder to the fist, in chest space (out + = away from the body on that side; [0, 0, -100] hangs down, [100, 0, 0] punches ahead); bend = elbow bend in degrees (0 = straight); twist = degrees the elbow swings round the arm from its natural direction (back and down)
legL legR  [forward, out, up, bend, twist]  hip to ankle in pelvis space; bend: the knee; twist: from pointing forward
footL footR [down, out, toes]   degrees the foot points down from standing, turns outward, and the toes bend up
blade  [forward, right, up]   (sword clips) the direction of a blade held in the right fist, in chest space
root   [forward, right]       (clips that travel) how far the whole body has moved, in percent of standing hip height

UAL1.label: Quaternius Universal Animation Library 1
UAL1.origin: Universal Animation Library by Quaternius: the free Standard edition (45 clips and a T-pose), as Quaternius exports it for Godot

UAL2.label: Quaternius Universal Animation Library 2
UAL2.origin: Universal Animation Library 2 by Quaternius: the free Standard edition (42 clips), as Quaternius exports it for Unreal and Godot

A_TPose.desc: T-pose, arms straight out: the rest pose every clip is measured from

Chest_Open.desc: bends forward and lifts a chest's lid with both hands, then straightens

ClimbUp_1m_RM.desc: grabs a ledge about 1 m high and hauls up onto it (travels)

Consume.desc: eats or drinks: lifts the left hand to the mouth, tips the head, lowers it

Crouch_Idle_Loop.desc: crouched low and still, looking about

Dance_Loop.desc: a one-second groove: hips sway, arms swing out

Death01.desc: staggers and falls flat on the back

Driving_Loop.desc: seated, hands on a steering wheel, small turns

Farm_Harvest.desc: bends down and pulls a crop up out of the ground

Farm_PlantSeed.desc: kneels, presses a seed into the soil, stands

Farm_Watering.desc: tips a watering can held in the right hand, sweeping it over the ground

Fixing_Kneeling.desc: kneels on one knee and works with both hands near the ground

Hit_Chest.desc: takes a blow to the chest: torso snaps back, recovers

Hit_Head.desc: takes a blow to the head: head snaps aside, recovers

Hit_Knockback.desc: hit hard: thrown back off the feet onto the back, and lies there

Hit_Knockback_RM.desc: hit hard and thrown back onto the back, travelling backward

Idle_FoldArms_Loop.desc: standing with the arms folded across the chest, shifting weight: waiting, listening

Idle_Lantern_Loop.desc: standing, holding a lantern out in front in the right hand

Idle_Loop.desc: standing at rest, breathing and shifting weight

Idle_Rail_Call.desc: leaning on a railing, raises the right hand to wave or call out, then leans back on it

Idle_Rail_Loop.desc: leaning forward on the forearms, as over a railing

Idle_Shield_Break.desc: the guard breaks: knocked back off balance with the arms flung out, recovers

Idle_Shield_Loop.desc: guarding: the left forearm held across the chest behind a shield

Idle_TalkingPhone_Loop.desc: on the phone: right hand at the ear, left arm across the body

Idle_Talking_Loop.desc: standing and talking with hand gestures

Idle_Torch_Loop.desc: standing with one arm raised, holding up a torch or lantern

Interact.desc: reaches forward at chest height and works something with the hands (a lever, a door, a box)

Jump_Land.desc: lands from a fall, knees soak it up, stands

Jump_Loop.desc: airborne pose held while rising or falling

Jump_Start.desc: dips, then springs up with the arms thrown out (in place: the game lifts the body)

LayToIdle.desc: gets up from lying on the back to standing

Melee_Hook.desc: a big lunging hook swing that carries low to the ground

Melee_Hook_Rec.desc: recovers from the hook back to standing

NinjaJump_Idle_Loop.desc: airborne ninja pose held: body forward, arms swept back

NinjaJump_Land.desc: lands from the ninja leap in a crouch, hands near the ground, and stands

NinjaJump_Start.desc: crouches and leaps into a running ninja's air pose, arms swept back

OverhandThrow.desc: winds up and throws overhand with the right arm, following through

PickUp_Table.desc: reaches out and picks something up from table height

Pistol_Aim_Neutral.desc: two-handed pistol aim, level (a pose to blend with up and down)

Pistol_Idle_Loop.desc: standing ready, pistol held low in both hands

Punch_Cross.desc: rear-hand straight punch with a hip turn

Punch_Enter.desc: brings the fists up into a fighting stance

Punch_Jab.desc: quick lead-hand jab from the stance

Push_Loop.desc: leans in and shoves something heavy, stepping

Roll.desc: forward roll over the shoulder and back to standing, in place

Shield_OneShot.desc: a quick block: snaps the shield arm up across the chest, then lowers it

Sitting_Enter.desc: sits down onto a seat (no chair is drawn)

Slide_Exit.desc: springs up out of the slide into a run

Slide_Loop.desc: sliding feet first, leaning back on one hand

Slide_Start.desc: drops from a run into a feet-first slide on the back

Spell_Simple_Enter.desc: raises a hand to ready a spell

Sprint_Loop.desc: full sprint with big arm swings, in place

Sword_Block.desc: braces and raises the sword to block, then recovers

Sword_Idle.desc: standing ready with a sword in the right hand

Sword_Regular_A.desc: the combo's first strike: crouches and thrusts forward

Sword_Regular_A_Rec.desc: recovers from the first strike back to standing

Sword_Regular_B.desc: the combo's second strike: a low, wide sweeping slash

Sword_Regular_B_Rec.desc: recovers from the second strike back to standing

Sword_Regular_C.desc: the combo's finisher: a big overhead slash down to the ground, then stands

Sword_Regular_Combo.desc: the three strikes chained: thrust, sweep, finisher

TreeChopping_Loop.desc: chops with an axe: swings from over the shoulder down into a tree

Walk_Carry_Loop.desc: walking with a box held in both arms in front, in place

Yes.desc: agrees: raises the left hand out in front (a thumbs-up), holds it, lowers it

Zombie_Idle_Loop.desc: hunched and swaying, arms hanging: a zombie at rest

Zombie_Scratch.desc: lunges and claws down with both hands, then settles back

Zombie_Walk_Fwd_Loop.desc: shambling, dragging zombie walk, in place
